api/src/routers/oauth_sso.py.name: Work-account sign-in
api/src/routers/oauth_sso.py.description: Lets people sign in with Microsoft, Google or another company account, and shows which accounts they have linked.

api/src/routers/organizations.py.name: Client organizations
api/src/routers/organizations.py.description: Keeps the list of client organizations that people, automations and records belong to.

api/src/routers/packages.py.name: Extra code libraries
api/src/routers/packages.py.description: Adds or removes the extra libraries workflows can call on, then restarts the parts that run them.

api/src/routers/passkeys.py.name: Fingerprint sign-in
api/src/routers/passkeys.py.description: Registers a device's fingerprint or face unlock so someone can sign in without typing a password.

api/src/routers/permissions.py.name: Permission list
api/src/routers/permissions.py.description: Lists every action that can be allowed or blocked, so the role screens offer the same choices everywhere.

api/src/routers/platform_jobs.py.name: Long-running jobs
api/src/routers/platform_jobs.py.description: Shows the progress of long tasks the platform runs in the background and lets someone stop one.

api/src/routers/platform/__init__.py.name: Platform admin section
api/src/routers/platform/__init__.py.description: Groups together the administrator-only requests that monitor how the platform itself is running.

api/src/routers/platform/workers.py.name: Processing capacity
api/src/routers/platform/workers.py.description: Shows the queues and running processes that carry out work, and lets an administrator restart stuck ones.

api/src/routers/policy_rules.py.name: Reusable access rules
api/src/routers/policy_rules.py.description: Keeps named, reusable rules that decide who may open files and records, so one rule can be applied in many places.

api/src/routers/product_updates.py.name: What's new
api/src/routers/product_updates.py.description: Delivers the release notes for this version and remembers which ones each person has already seen.

api/src/routers/profile.py.name: Personal profile
api/src/routers/profile.py.description: Lets people update their own name, contact details, photo and password.

api/src/routers/required_instructions.py.name: Standing AI instructions
api/src/routers/required_instructions.py.description: Sets wording every AI assistant must follow, for the whole platform and for individual clients.

api/src/routers/roi_reports.py.name: Savings reports
api/src/routers/roi_reports.py.description: Estimates time and money saved by automation over a period, broken down by automation and by client.

api/src/routers/roi_settings.py.name: Savings assumptions
api/src/routers/roi_settings.py.description: Holds the hourly rates and overheads used to work out the savings figures.

api/src/routers/roles.py.name: Roles and access
api/src/routers/roles.py.description: Defines who can do what by grouping people, forms, apps, assistants and automations into roles.

api/src/routers/run_retention.py.name: Run history window
api/src/routers/run_retention.py.description: States how long finished run histories are kept so screens can explain why an old one has gone.

api/src/routers/scheduler_diagnostics.py.name: Scheduled work health
api/src/routers/scheduler_diagnostics.py.description: Shows whether the timetable that starts scheduled work is running and what it has done lately.

api/src/routers/schedules.py.name: Timetable checking
api/src/routers/schedules.py.description: Checks a schedule's timing rule and shows the next few times it would run.

api/src/routers/sdk_modules.py.name: Shared code delivery
api/src/routers/sdk_modules.py.description: Hands workspace code and its list of needed libraries to the parts that run workflows.

api/src/routers/sdk_runtime.py.name: Run-time support
api/src/routers/sdk_runtime.py.description: Carries log lines, saved lookup results and service signals between running workflows and the main server.

GET /auth/oauth/providers.name: Which sign-in options
GET /auth/oauth/providers.description: Lists the company sign-in options offered on the sign-in screen.

GET /auth/oauth/init/{provider}.name: Start work-account sign-in
GET /auth/oauth/init/{provider}.description: Sends the person to their chosen provider to sign in.

POST /auth/oauth/callback.name: Finish work-account sign-in
POST /auth/oauth/callback.description: Completes sign-in with the provider and either signs the person in or links the account.

GET /auth/oauth/accounts.name: My linked accounts
GET /auth/oauth/accounts.description: Lists the outside sign-in accounts linked to the signed-in person.

DELETE /auth/oauth/accounts/{provider}.name: Unlink an account
DELETE /auth/oauth/accounts/{provider}.description: Removes the link to one outside sign-in account.

GET /api/organizations.name: Client list
GET /api/organizations.description: Lists client organizations, with the provider's own organization first.

POST /api/organizations.name: Add a client
POST /api/organizations.description: Creates a client organization to hold its people, records and automations.

PATCH /api/organizations/{org_id}.name: Update a client
PATCH /api/organizations/{org_id}.description: Changes a client organization's name or settings.

DELETE /api/organizations/{org_id}.name: Archive a client
DELETE /api/organizations/{org_id}.description: Marks a client organization as inactive without erasing its history.

GET /api/packages.name: Installed extras
GET /api/packages.description: Lists the extra libraries currently available to workflows.

GET /api/packages/updates.name: Check for newer versions
GET /api/packages/updates.description: Checks whether newer versions of the installed libraries exist.

POST /api/packages/install.name: Add a library
POST /api/packages/install.description: Installs an extra library and restarts the parts that run workflows so it can be used.

DELETE /api/packages/{package_name}.name: Remove a library
DELETE /api/packages/{package_name}.description: Uninstalls an extra library and restarts the parts that run workflows.

POST /auth/passkeys/register/options.name: Start adding a passkey
POST /auth/passkeys/register/options.description: Prepares what the device needs in order to create a fingerprint or face sign-in.

POST /auth/passkeys/register/verify.name: Confirm a passkey
POST /auth/passkeys/register/verify.description: Checks the device's answer and saves the passkey for next time.

POST /auth/passkeys/authenticate/options.name: Start passkey sign-in
POST /auth/passkeys/authenticate/options.description: Prepares the challenge a device answers when someone signs in with a passkey.

POST /auth/passkeys/authenticate/verify.name: Finish passkey sign-in
POST /auth/passkeys/authenticate/verify.description: Confirms the device's answer and signs the person in.

GET /auth/passkeys.name: My passkeys
GET /auth/passkeys.description: Lists the passkeys the signed-in person has added.

DELETE /auth/passkeys/{passkey_id}.name: Remove a passkey
DELETE /auth/passkeys/{passkey_id}.description: Deletes one passkey so that device can no longer be used to sign in.

GET /api/permissions/catalog.name: All permissions
GET /api/permissions/catalog.description: Lists every permission the platform recognises, so role screens offer consistent choices.

GET /api/platform-jobs.name: Background job list
GET /api/platform-jobs.description: Lists the long-running tasks the platform is working on.

GET /api/platform-jobs/{job_id}.name: Job progress
GET /api/platform-jobs/{job_id}.description: Shows how one long-running task is going and how far it has got.

POST /api/platform-jobs/{job_id}/cancel.name: Stop a long task
POST /api/platform-jobs/{job_id}/cancel.description: Asks a long-running task to stop.

GET /api/platform/workers/metrics.name: Processing use over time
GET /api/platform/workers/metrics.description: Shows how much memory and processing power the running processes have used.

GET /api/platform/workers/stats.name: Pool totals
GET /api/platform/workers/stats.description: Summarises how many processes are running, busy or idle.

GET /api/platform/workers.name: Worker pools
GET /api/platform/workers.description: Lists the groups of processes that carry out work.

GET /api/platform/workers/{worker_id}.name: One worker pool
GET /api/platform/workers/{worker_id}.description: Shows the processes inside one pool and what each is doing.

POST /api/platform/workers/{worker_id}/p.name: Restart one process
POST /api/platform/workers/{worker_id}/p.description: Restarts a single process so it starts again with a clean slate.

POST /api/platform/workers/{worker_id}/r.name: Restart a whole pool
POST /api/platform/workers/{worker_id}/r.description: Restarts every process in a pool, one after another.

GET /api/platform/queue.name: Waiting work
GET /api/platform/queue.description: Lists the tasks waiting to be picked up.

GET /api/platform/stuck-history.name: Stuck work history
GET /api/platform/stuck-history.description: Summarises which automations have got stuck most often recently.

POST /api/policy-rules.name: Add a rule
POST /api/policy-rules.description: Creates a named, reusable rule controlling who may open files and records.

GET /api/policy-rules.name: Rules I can see
GET /api/policy-rules.description: Lists the rules available in the current organization's scope.

GET /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}.name: Rule details
GET /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}.description: Shows the conditions of one rule.

PUT /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}.name: Change a rule
PUT /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}.description: Updates a rule's conditions everywhere it is used.

DELETE /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}.name: Delete a rule
DELETE /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}.description: Removes a rule so it can no longer be applied.

GET /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}/us.name: Where a rule is used
GET /api/policy-rules/{domain}/{name}/us.description: Lists the files and tables that rely on a rule, so it is not deleted by accident.

GET /api/product-updates.name: Release notes
GET /api/product-updates.description: Returns this version's release notes and which ones the person has already seen.

POST /api/product-updates/receipts.name: Mark notes as seen
POST /api/product-updates/receipts.description: Records that a person has seen particular release notes.

GET /api/profile.name: My profile
GET /api/profile.description: Shows the signed-in person's name, contact details and photo.

PATCH /api/profile.name: Update my profile
PATCH /api/profile.description: Saves changes to the person's own name and contact details.

POST /api/profile/avatar.name: Upload a photo
POST /api/profile/avatar.description: Stores a new profile photo for the person.

POST /api/profile/password.name: Set my password
POST /api/profile/password.description: Changes or sets the password used to sign in.

GET /api/required-instructions.name: Instructions in force
GET /api/required-instructions.description: Returns the standing wording that applies to the signed-in person's AI assistants.

GET /api/admin/required-instructions.name: Platform-wide instructions
GET /api/admin/required-instructions.description: Shows the wording every AI assistant on the platform must follow.

PUT /api/admin/required-instructions.name: Change platform instructions
PUT /api/admin/required-instructions.description: Updates the wording every AI assistant on the platform must follow.

GET /api/admin/required-instructions/org.name: Client instructions
GET /api/admin/required-instructions/org.description: Shows the extra wording AI assistants must follow for one client.

PUT /api/admin/required-instructions/org.name: Change client instructions
PUT /api/admin/required-instructions/org.description: Updates the extra wording AI assistants must follow for one client.

GET /api/reports/roi/summary.name: Savings summary
GET /api/reports/roi/summary.description: Estimates hours and money saved by automation over the chosen period.

GET /api/reports/roi/by-workflow.name: Savings by automation
GET /api/reports/roi/by-workflow.description: Shows which automations save the most time and money.

GET /api/reports/roi/by-organization.name: Savings by client
GET /api/reports/roi/by-organization.description: Shows how much each client organization saves through automation.

GET /api/reports/roi/trends.name: Savings over time
GET /api/reports/roi/trends.description: Shows how savings have changed month by month.

GET /api/admin/roi/settings.name: Savings assumptions
GET /api/admin/roi/settings.description: Shows the hourly rates and overheads used in savings calculations.

POST /api/admin/roi/settings.name: Change savings assumptions
POST /api/admin/roi/settings.description: Updates the hourly rates and overheads behind the savings figures.

GET /api/roles.name: Roles list
GET /api/roles.description: Lists roles with a summary of what each one covers.

POST /api/roles.name: Create a role
POST /api/roles.description: Creates a role to group the people, forms, apps, assistants and automations it covers.

GET /api/roles/{role_id}.name: Role details
GET /api/roles/{role_id}.description: Shows one role and where it is used.

PATCH /api/roles/{role_id}.name: Edit a role
PATCH /api/roles/{role_id}.description: Changes a role's name or description.

PUT /api/roles/{role_id}.name: Save a role
PUT /api/roles/{role_id}.description: Saves a role's details in one go, kept so older tools keep working.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}.name: Delete a role
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}.description: Removes a role and takes it off everyone who had it.

GET /api/roles/{role_id}/users.name: People in a role
GET /api/roles/{role_id}/users.description: Lists the people holding a role, limited to clients the viewer may see.

POST /api/roles/{role_id}/users.name: Add people to a role
POST /api/roles/{role_id}/users.description: Gives a role to one or more people.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/users/{user_.name: Remove a person from a role
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/users/{user_.description: Takes a role away from one person.

GET /api/roles/{role_id}/forms.name: Forms in a role
GET /api/roles/{role_id}/forms.description: Lists the forms a role can open.

POST /api/roles/{role_id}/forms.name: Add forms to a role
POST /api/roles/{role_id}/forms.description: Gives a role access to one or more forms.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/forms/{form_.name: Remove a form from a role
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/forms/{form_.description: Takes one form out of a role.

GET /api/roles/{role_id}/agents.name: Assistants in a role
GET /api/roles/{role_id}/agents.description: Lists the AI assistants a role can use.

POST /api/roles/{role_id}/agents.name: Add assistants to a role
POST /api/roles/{role_id}/agents.description: Gives a role access to one or more AI assistants.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/agents/{agen.name: Remove an assistant from a role
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/agents/{agen.description: Takes one AI assistant out of a role.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/users.name: Remove several people
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/users.description: Takes a role away from several people at once.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/forms.name: Remove several forms
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/forms.description: Takes several forms out of a role at once.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/agents.name: Remove several assistants
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/agents.description: Takes several AI assistants out of a role at once.

GET /api/roles/{role_id}/apps.name: Apps in a role
GET /api/roles/{role_id}/apps.description: Lists the apps a role can open.

POST /api/roles/{role_id}/apps.name: Add apps to a role
POST /api/roles/{role_id}/apps.description: Gives a role access to one or more apps.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/apps.name: Remove several apps
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/apps.description: Takes several apps out of a role at once.

GET /api/roles/{role_id}/workflows.name: Automations in a role
GET /api/roles/{role_id}/workflows.description: Lists the automations a role may run.

POST /api/roles/{role_id}/workflows.name: Add automations to a role
POST /api/roles/{role_id}/workflows.description: Gives a role permission to run one or more automations.

DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/workflows.name: Remove several automations
DELETE /api/roles/{role_id}/workflows.description: Takes several automations out of a role at once.

GET /api/roles/{role_id}/permissions.name: What a role may do
GET /api/roles/{role_id}/permissions.description: Lists the actions a role is allowed to perform.

PUT /api/roles/{role_id}/permissions.name: Set what a role may do
PUT /api/roles/{role_id}/permissions.description: Replaces the list of actions a role is allowed to perform.

GET /api/run-retention.name: Run history window
GET /api/run-retention.description: States how long finished runs are kept, so screens can explain why an old run has gone.

GET /api/platform/scheduler.name: Timetable health
GET /api/platform/scheduler.description: Shows whether the part that starts scheduled work is running and when it last checked.

GET /api/platform/scheduler/tasks/{task_.name: Scheduled task history
GET /api/platform/scheduler/tasks/{task_.description: Shows recent runs of one scheduled task and how each one ended.

POST /api/schedules/validate.name: Check a schedule
POST /api/schedules/validate.description: Checks a timing rule and shows the next few times it would run.

GET /api/sdk/modules/{path:path}.name: Fetch shared code
GET /api/sdk/modules/{path:path}.description: Hands a piece of workspace code to the part that needs to run it.

GET /api/sdk/modules-resolve.name: Find shared code
GET /api/sdk/modules-resolve.description: Finds which workspace file a name refers to when code is loaded.

GET /api/sdk/requirements.name: List needed libraries
GET /api/sdk/requirements.description: Returns the list of extra libraries the workspace depends on.

POST /api/sdk/runtime/logs.name: Save a log line
POST /api/sdk/runtime/logs.description: Records a line of run output so it appears in the run history.

POST /api/sdk/runtime/service-control.name: Service instructions
POST /api/sdk/runtime/service-control.description: Reports whether a helper service that workflows rely on should be running.

POST /api/sdk/runtime/data-provider-cach.name: Read saved lookup results
POST /api/sdk/runtime/data-provider-cach.description: Returns previously saved results from an outside data source instead of asking again.

POST /api/sdk/runtime/data-provider-cach.name: Save lookup results
POST /api/sdk/runtime/data-provider-cach.description: Stores results from an outside data source so later runs can reuse them.

GET /api/sdk/runtime/logs/{execution_id}.name: Run output
GET /api/sdk/runtime/logs/{execution_id}.description: Returns the captured output of one run.
